projectTitle: ERP Built Around a Real Safety-Supply Workflow
summary: A custom ERP designed around Shieldmax Safety's quotation, delivery-order, expense and operational workflow.
challenge: Critical commercial documents and expenses were difficult to manage consistently, while generic software did not match the business's working process.
approach: Evolix mapped the actual workflow first and then connected quotations, delivery orders, expenses and operational records inside one practical system.
outcome: One organised system aligned with the client's own workflow, making core commercial and operational processes easier to manage.

testimonial.quote: Before working with Evolix, managing quotations, delivery orders and expenses across the business was difficult. Their team understood how we actually work and built an ERP around our process instead of giving us a standard, ready-made system. Everything is now organised in one place and much easier to manage. I am genuinely grateful for the care they put into customising it for us.
